en.html:
…God is targeting me to warp space.
As long as I remain in its sight, the danger stays.

Then I should make it lose sight of me!
It has no proper intelligence. Finding me again should take time…!

Good.
I had slipped behind a suitable rock.

For caution's sake, I silenced my movements too.

…Now I should be <ruby>gone<rt>lost</rt></ruby> from God's awareness.

Not far from the enemy here.
Wait for an opening, leap out, fire the electromagnetic draw—

Finished!

ja.html:
良し。
　うまく、適当な岩陰へ潜り込めだ。

　念のため、音も殺す。

　……これで〝神〟の認識から俺は<ruby>消失<rt>ロスト</rt></ruby>しただろう。

　距離上、ここは敵からそう遠くない。
　隙を見て飛び出し、電磁抜刀を撃ち――

　それで、終わりだ！
